summary: Eps 37-38 are the anime's last real contact with the manga before the fully anime-original ending (eps 39-51, already typed anime-only-canon). Fandom's per-episode pages are explicit: ep 37 'does not have any corresponding chapters' (it follows up manga Brew events and features Joe Buttataki's arrival, a chapter-38 element, but adapts nothing directly), so it gets no anchor — only a loose_parallel annotation. Ep 38 is the true final manga anchor: fandom's episode infobox gives 'anime correspondent = Chapter 38 and Chapter 39', cross-checked by the reverse fields on the Chapter 38 page (anime correspondent = Episode 38) and Chapter 39 prose (Black☆Star vs Kid duel adapted as Episode 38); the adaptation is partial and heavily altered (Joe's role changed, ch 39's Joe death and Maka's Medusa discovery never adapted). Typing of ep 37 is disputed between sources (fandom: no chapters; animefillerlist: Manga Canon through 38) — flagged rather than corrected.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 38-39 (partial: Black☆Star vs Kid duel from ch 39; Joe's arrival/mole setup from ch 38; heavily altered)
anchors.note: Final manga-contact episode; fandom episode infobox 'anime correspondent = Chapter 38 and Chapter 39', reverse-confirmed on both chapter pages; AFL corroborates ep 38 as the last Manga Canon episode. Marked medium because the adaptation is loose and no independent source names the exact chapters.

continue_points.note: Chapters 38-39 only partially/loosely adapted (ch 38's Marie reunion + mole investigation and ch 39's Joe death / Maka's Medusa discovery never happen in the anime), so the honest resume is ch 38 itself, not END+1; divergence guides commonly suggest backing up to ch 36 for full context.

annotations.note: Follows up manga Brew-arc events and features Joe Buttataki's arrival to Death City (a ch-38 event), but fandom states the episode 'does not have any corresponding chapters' — no anchor issued.

Partial/altered adaptation: Joe arrives as a demon-tool engineer instead of an internal investigator; ch 39's fatal outcome and Maka's discovery are dropped. After this episode the anime is entirely original.

structure.notes: Divergence sequence confirmed: ep 36 = ch 36-37 (existing anchor holds), ep 37 = no corresponding chapters, ep 38 = loose partial of ch 38-39, eps 39-51 = anime-original ending (already typed anime-only-canon). Sources disagree on where the clean break is: animefillerlist keeps Manga Canon through ep 38; syou-getsu.biz claims anime-original from ep 36 onward; fandom (most granular) is the basis used.
